title: Happy Ending
desc: Yudi is suffering from writer's block and his publishers decide to stop supporting him and instead publish the work of an Indian bestselling author. So, he must do something soon to maintain his fame.

title: Maidan E Jung
desc: Arjun learns that his sister loves a man who is about to get married and makes efforts to unite them. But when he learns that his sister's in-laws plan to kill her, he sets out to teach them a lesson.
